displaySkuNote: US 55-inch C3 example from LG.com; other sizes share the C3 webOS platform.
avrFactoryInputNote: AVR-X3800H Input Assign defaults: CBL/SAT=HDMI1, Media Player=HDMI2, Blu-ray=HDMI3, Game=HDMI4, AUX1=HDMI5, AUX2=HDMI6. Source Rename / HDMI device-name detection can change the string exposed as media_player.source — copy the live attribute into contracts source_contains.
tvHdmiNote: webOS source strings come from the TV source_list (often 'HDMI 2'). Renamed inputs can break select_source; prefer the label shown in Developer Tools → States.
denonNetworkPorts: HA denonavr needs TCP 23, 8080, and 60006 on the AVR when using VLANs.
